q: What goes into the CBAM figure for steel from a gas-based DRI plant in Misrata?
title: Misrata DRI steel CBAM figure
short: Natural gas used to reduce iron ore in the DRI plant, carried into the steel as a precursor, plus electrode and charge carbon and gas at the melt shop and rolling mill. Electricity is not counted. Gas-based DRI usually gives a lower figure than a blast furnace.
audience: Steel exporters in Misrata and their EU importers

p: Reforming natural gas and reducing the ore releases CO2. Those emissions, per tonne of DRI, become precursor emissions in the steel made from it.

sections.h: The melt shop and rolling mill
ul: Electrode and injected carbon in the electric furnace.
Any scrap added counts as zero.
Gas meter readings for the DRI plant and the rolling mill.
DRI output and its carbon content.
Charge mix per heat: DRI, scrap and any pig iron.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and production documents into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions an EU importer asks for.
